run.display_title: Run WebKit recovery offline after its local file navigation

head_commit.message:
Run WebKit recovery offline after its local file navigation

Pinned Playwright 1.58.2 rejects file navigation when WebKit offline emulation is enabled before loading. Keep actual file:// recovery, deny and record all HTTP from context creation, then enable and assert offline mode before archive inputs, decryption and every download. Chromium and Firefox retain pre-navigation offline mode.

Preserve all byte, rejection, storage and stale-plaintext assertions. Document the exact three-engine modes; no decoder runtime change.
